items.title: A criterion for purity along a fibre in terms of the relative associated primes inside the image of an etale neighbourhood
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the purity criterion used throughout the chapter: under the standing hypotheses it says that F is pure along the fibre if and only if the image of the etale morphism contains the relative associated points of the pullback that specialize into the fibre (statement lines 5196-5219, tag 05L4). The proof reduces the base to the etale neighbourhood and its localisation, proves the forward direction through the specialization of associated points and the openness of the image of g, and then proves the converse by base changing to the henselization, lifting a relative associated point along the etale morphism via the associated point lemma for etale maps, and using purity of the pulled back module to produce the required specialization inside the fibre. The henselization step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
